description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Checkout' which renders a UI for an e-commerce checkout screen. It includes static layout elements such as stepper, payment options, navigation, and a continue button. The component emits callbacks 'onBack' and 'onContinue' when user interacts with navigation and action buttons.

methods.name: Checkout({ onBack, onContinue })
methods.description: React functional component for rendering the checkout UI, utilizing props 'onBack' and 'onContinue' for callback actions.
